combo_label: School Days × Sailing & Boats × The Blitz

entries.clue: Tide sliding back out again after high water
Cut across a park in the Munich crisis, later lined with precast concrete
Twin-hulled craft that skims along flat instead of leaning over
Nightly rule against showing any light, in force from September 1939
Leading edge of a sail, first to shiver if you point too near the wind
Keeper of the keys and the mop, first in and last to lock up
Horizontal pole along the foot of a sail, sweeping across the cockpit as you turn
Incendiary device released thirty-six to a canister over a single street
Den children never enter, smelling of coffee and old smoke
Tapered hardwood spike for prising open the strands of a rope
Adding and taking away, worked in a column down the page
Tiered sleeping berth fitted on Underground platforms from 1941
Dullard of old, stood in the corner in a pointed paper cap
Jagged metal splinters children picked up in the street after a raid
